translation: When the middle region is as if external, it is the foot Yang Ming Stomach; when it moves it causes headache and red face. Slippery is fluid-retention, floating is unfavorable defecation, rough is fondness of lying down, intestinal rumbling, inability to eat, and bi of the foot and shin. When the rear region is as if external, it is the foot Lesser Yang Gallbladder; when it moves it causes pain of the lower back, spine, shin, thigh, and limb joints.
